chatlist.title: Chats
chatlist.empty.title: Your chats will appear here
chatlist.empty.text: Find family and friends by username or from your phone book — and say hello first.
chatlist.placeholder.title: Choose a chat
chatlist.placeholder.text: Open a chat on the left or start a new conversation.
chatlist.archive.title: Archive
chatlist.archive.emptyText: Chats you move out of the main list end up here.
chatlist.archive.hint: Archived chats stay out of your main list. You still get their notifications unless the chat is muted.
chatlist.mute.title: Mute notifications
chatlist.mute.forever: Until I turn it back on
chatlist.clear.title: Clear history?
chatlist.clear.text: All messages in “{0}” will disappear for you. This can't be undone.
chatlist.clear.savedText: All Saved Messages will be deleted. This can't be undone.
chatlist.delete.title: Delete the chat with “{0}”?
chatlist.delete.text: The chat and its messages will disappear from your list. This can't be undone.
chatlist.leave.title: Leave “{0}”?
chatlist.leave.text: You will stop getting messages from this group. You can come back with an invite.
chatlist.leave.ownerText: You own this group: an admin or the longest-standing member will take it over.
chatlist.deleteGroup.title: Delete “{0}”?
chatlist.deleteGroup.text: The group and all its messages will disappear for every member. This can't be undone.
